inclusions.text: Hotel pickup in Cairo by guide and driver
inclusions.source: The day begins with an early departure from Cairo — your guide and driver will collect you from your hotel before the city's traffic builds to its full morning pitch.
Character · Fully private · own licensed Egyptologist · air-conditioned vehicle · adults only (minimum age 18, given the long drive) · tiered pricing with optional entrance-fee and lunch bundles
